feedback_prompts: ZIG-ZAG FEEDBACK 1 — Revise synthesis.md without new sources, architecture, implementation, or authority claims. Apply all three round-1 reviewer repairs: (1) downgrade SQLite/CAS to SELECT FOR FUTURE CANDIDATE DESIGN, OWNER-BLOCKED; downgrade the mapped composition/story namespaces to DEFER OWNER BINDING; narrow canonical Whisper ownership to the meanings and standalone components actually observed, leaving command/event, transition, admission, identity/privacy, journal, reducer, and execution contracts proposal-only; keep co-op research-local and zero-authority. (2) Rename run-local kinds to AuthorIntentArtifact, CompositionPlanArtifact, NarrativeExcerptArtifact, CandidateCharacterEntity, CandidatePlaceEntity, CandidateEncounterEntity; remove EvidenceRecord as an ontology node and split EvidenceArtifact, EvidenceAssessment, and Receipt; split RunReducer from RunStateSnapshot; split lifecycle_phase, pending_gate, correction_state, and outcome_ceiling; split assertion_provenance, assessment_kind, and authority_grant_ref; repair edges to closed, typed forms including conforms_to_plan, assessed_by, transition_evidenced_by, and receipt_invalidated_by_correction; define command rejection as a non-semantic rejection record unless an owner explicitly says otherwise. (3) Turn the Mara/Ivo fixture into a proposed byte-bound acceptance contract: exact raw intent, closure, command/revision sequence, audition/draft/graph/evidence/residue/projection digests, actors/challenges, journal head and replay digest; separate missing approval from missing comprehension; split stale closure/artifact/surface; make correction after mechanical pass mandatory; split both crash points; split runtime/journal, ontology-promotion, and public/deployment denied writes with protected before/after digests; kill precedes for L0 unless adding a second encounter; instantiate or kill every retained node/edge; specify GraphValidationReceipt with snapshot, policy/closure digest, diagnostics, result, validator identity, and authority_effect:none. Preserve OX-01/RX-01 bindings and observed versus unverified status. Return a self-contained Synthesis Revision 1, a repair-closure matrix, remaining owner blockers, and VERDICT: READY_FOR_REREVIEW or BLOCK. Do not edit files.

REREVIEW ROUND 2 — Read projects/co-op-engine/research/2026-08-05-whisper-ontology-runtime/synthesis-revision-1.md and re-evaluate only the precedent, owner, duplication, topology-disposition, and public/private repairs from your round-1 review. Confirm whether SQLite/CAS is correctly owner-blocked, namespaces are deferred to owner binding, canonical Whisper ownership is narrowed to observed meanings/components, all runtime/graph components remain proposal-only, and co-op remains a zero-authority research adapter. Return VERDICT: PASS or VERDICT: REPAIR with only remaining exact defects and bindings. Do not edit files, add sources, implement, deploy, promote, or widen scope.

REREVIEW ROUND 2 — Read projects/co-op-engine/research/2026-08-05-whisper-ontology-runtime/synthesis-revision-1.md and re-evaluate only the finite-witness repairs from your round-1 review. Check exact raw bytes/digest obligations, command→event→revision sequence, instantiated draft/graph/evidence boundaries, separate approval/comprehension and stale controls, mandatory correction, both crash points, duplicate semantics, split denied writes, killed vacuous precedes, complete retained node/edge instantiation, and GraphValidationReceipt fields. Return VERDICT: PASS or VERDICT: REPAIR with only remaining exact defects. Remember this is an unexecuted acceptance contract, not implementation proof. Do not edit files or widen scope.

REREVIEW ROUND 2 — Read projects/co-op-engine/research/2026-08-05-whisper-ontology-runtime/synthesis-revision-1.md and re-evaluate only the definitional and authority non-collapse repairs from your round-1 review. Check renamed run-local artifacts/entities, EvidenceArtifact/EvidenceAssessment/Receipt split, RunReducer/RunStateSnapshot split, independent lifecycle/gate/correction/ceiling and provenance/assessment/authority axes, non-semantic rejection boundary, closed typed edges, exact authority wording, co-op adapter boundary, and reachability/deployment claim ceiling. Return VERDICT: PASS or VERDICT: REPAIR with only remaining exact defects. Do not edit files, add architecture, or widen scope.

ZIG-ZAG FEEDBACK 2 — Produce Synthesis Revision 2 from OX-01, RX-01, revision 1, and review-round-2 only. This is the final allowed repair turn. Close these exact defects without implementation or new sources: (1) define immutable future fixture paths and exact UTF-8/JSON byte rules for plan v1/v2, audition v1/v2, surfaces, draft v1/v2, correction, editorial evidence, comprehension evidence, graph snapshot/policy, residue, state snapshot, and projection; include literal example draft and human evidence payloads while keeping every digest a manifest obligation, not a claim of computed bytes. (2) Expand the command/event contract so every command names expected revision, exact scheduled/completed event types, resulting revision, lifecycle_phase, pending_gate, correction_state, outcome_ceiling, produced artifact IDs, assessment/receipt IDs, and journal-head field. Name EV10 and EV21 and all omitted events. (3) Bind EV07/EV18 editorial decisions and EV25 comprehension to exact actors, challenges/sessions, artifact and surface fields, decision/questions/answers bytes, assessment IDs, and receipt IDs. (4) Make stale closure, artifact, and surface controls exact: command, changed field, expected-vs-actual digest fixture refs, rejection code, unchanged revision/head, zero activity starts, and rejection receipt ID. (5) Instantiate every retained EvidenceArtifact. (6) Specify one canonical GraphSnapshot record containing all node records, edges, assertion owners/provenance, JSON canonicalization, and expected graph digest field. (7) Split RunStateSnapshot from RunProjection; instantiate RS26 and RP26 and state that rendering RP26 adds no event/revision. (8) Use assessment_kind mechanical_validation | editorial_decision | comprehension_assessment | post_apply_review | graph_policy plus separate kind-specific assessment_result; rename EditorialApprovalRecorded to EditorialDecisionRecorded and ComprehensionRecorded to ComprehensionAssessmentRecorded. (9) State unique meaning and forbidden substitutions for each relation; enumerate exact assessed_by subjects; rename transition_evidenced_by to event_evidenced_by with AcceptedEvent → Receipt. Return a repair-closure matrix, all remaining owner blockers, and VERDICT READY_FOR_FINAL_REVIEW or BLOCK. Do not edit files, add scope, or imply execution.

FINAL REVIEW AFTER LOOP 2 — Read synthesis-revision-2.md and confirm the final revision has not regressed your precedent, ownership, topology, co-op, or public/private PASS. Review only the frozen goal and your prior defects; do not introduce new scope. Return VERDICT: PASS or VERDICT: FAIL_AT_LOOP_CEILING with exact remaining defect. No edits, implementation, promotion, deployment, or new sources.

FINAL REVIEW AFTER LOOP 2 — Read synthesis-revision-2.md and re-evaluate only your remaining round-2 non-vacuity defects: immutable payload paths/bytes, full command/event/state/artifact/receipt contract, human bindings, exact stale controls, instantiated EvidenceArtifacts, canonical GraphSnapshot, and the previously closed correction/crash/duplicate/denied-write/GraphValidationReceipt controls. This is the loop ceiling. Return VERDICT: PASS or VERDICT: FAIL_AT_LOOP_CEILING with exact remaining load-bearing defect. Treat all fixture behavior as unexecuted. No edits or scope widening.

FINAL REVIEW AFTER LOOP 2 — Read synthesis-revision-2.md and re-evaluate only your remaining round-2 definitional defects: RunStateSnapshot versus RunProjection, assessment kind versus result and renamed events, exact relation meanings/subjects/forbidden substitutions, and AcceptedEvent→Receipt. This is the loop ceiling. Return VERDICT: PASS or VERDICT: FAIL_AT_LOOP_CEILING with exact remaining load-bearing defect. Do not edit files, add architecture, or widen scope.
